title: Routine Package Details & IAM Policy Members Added, Several Fields Now Read-Only
summary: BigQuery now provides detailed information about installed packages within routine build statuses and introduces a new schema for IAM policy members on tables. Be aware of breaking changes as several properties across `InstalledPackage`, `ResourcePolicyMember`, `RoutineBuildStatus`, and `Table` schemas have been made read-only.
details:
Developers can now gain deeper insights into their routine execution environments. The `RoutineBuildStatus` schema now includes a new `installedPackages` array, which contains `InstalledPackage` objects. Each `InstalledPackage` provides `name`, `sourceRepository`, and `version` of packages used in the routine, all exposed as output-only fields. This enhances visibility into UDF dependencies.

Additionally, the `Table` schema now exposes a `policyMember` property, which is an output-only `ResourcePolicyMember` object. This new schema provides `iamPolicyNamePrincipal` and `iamPolicyUidPrincipal` fields, allowing users to reference Google Cloud resources by name or UID in IAM policy bindings for views, simplifying authorization management.

**Breaking Change Alert**: Several properties have been made read-only. If your applications were previously attempting to write to `InstalledPackage.name`, `InstalledPackage.sourceRepository`, `InstalledPackage.version`, `ResourcePolicyMember.iamPolicyNamePrincipal`, `ResourcePolicyMember.iamPolicyUidPrincipal`, `RoutineBuildStatus.installedPackages`, or `Table.policyMember`, they will now encounter errors. Please update your code to reflect that these properties are now output-only.
